 International football competitions continue today, Thursday, November 12, 2026. A number of highly anticipated matches will take place in the UEFA Nations League and the Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers. Several exciting encounters between prominent national teams are also expected.
 The clash between England and Croatia stands out among the most anticipated matches in the UEFA Nations League. Additionally, Turkey will face Belgium, and the Czech Republic will play Spain. As for the Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers, several important matches are scheduled, most notably Senegal versus Sudan. Cameroon will also play Namibia, and Ivory Coast will face Gambia.
 Today’s matches, Thursday, November 12, 2026, and the broadcasting channels
 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers
 Ghana vs Somalia: 7 PM UAE time, 6 PM Saudi time, 5 PM Egypt time, via beIN SPORTS 2.
 Guinea vs Eritrea: 8 PM UAE time, 7 PM Saudi time, 6 PM Egypt time, via beIN SPORTS XTRA 2.
 Cameroon vs Namibia: 11 PM UAE time, 10 PM Saudi time, 9 PM Egypt time, on beIN SPORTS 6.
 Senegal vs Sudan: 11 PM UAE time, 10 PM Saudi time, 9 PM Egypt time, on beIN SPORTS 2.
 Ivory Coast vs Gambia: 11 PM UAE time, 10 PM Saudi time, 9 PM Egypt time, on beIN SPORTS 5.
 UEFA Nations League
 Türkiye vs Belgium: 9 PM UAE time, 8 PM Saudi time, 7 PM Egypt time, on beIN SPORTS 1.
 England vs Croatia: 11:45 PM UAE time, 10:45 PM Saudi time, 9:45 PM Egypt time, on beIN SPORTS 3.
 Czech Republic vs Spain: 11:45 PM UAE time, 10:45 PM Saudi time, 9:45 PM Egypt time, on beIN SPORTS 4.
